# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)

The probe inspects the trained GRU4Rec through ModelView; backbone implementation is not supplied. Relevant interfaces are `item_emb`, `log2feats(sequence)` producing B × L × H states, and `predict_score(features, items)`. The final sequence representation is selected at the maximum nonzero input position, correctly handling left padding; empty histories receive zero states.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks

`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` accesses `view.model`, training histories, and metadata interfaces. `run_full_diagnosis(train_loader)` consumes up to ten batches of `(None, sequence, positive, negative)` with B × L tensors. Feature extraction uses ModelView’s NumPy adapter. Temporal probes use training histories directly. Execution runs in evaluation/inference mode with seed 42; model mode and Python, NumPy, and Torch RNG states are restored afterward.

# Probes & Metrics

- **Embedding alignment:** Samples up to 2,048 real-item embeddings, excluding padding/reserved tokens. Maps mean pairwise cosine to [0,1]; higher indicates directional alignment, not demonstrated recommendation-diversity loss.
- **Sampled separation:** Computes positive-minus-negative scores at positions with nonzero sequence, positive, and negative IDs. Reports mean, lower tenth percentile, negative-win rate, and margin-below-0.5 rate. Larger margins and lower failure rates indicate stronger sampled training separation. Frequency strata include denominators; unavailable item-category breakdowns remain empty.
- **Execution checks:** Verify finite values, shapes, padding invariance, zero empty-history features, individual/batched scoring consistency, and parity with the module’s `score_candidates`. Failures disable temporal interpretation.

# Perturbation & Tests

For up to 200 eligible training users, select one training-prefix target and freeze its 99 unique negative candidates. Compare intact histories against oldest/recent/random deletions, local block shuffles, final-item removal, and last-item-only histories.

Measure target-rank change, HR@10 change, cosine distance, and normalized state displacement. Positive rank change or negative HR change indicates damage. State movement alone establishes sensitivity. Repeated interventions are averaged per user; summaries include length/repeat-status slices and conditional bootstrap intervals when sufficient users exist.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations

The returned object contains `metrics` and `metric_definitions`, including counts, execution checks, temporal outcomes/summaries, unavailable reasons, and runtime. `diagnosis_interpreter_prompt` requests grounded JSON interpretation.

Measurements concern fitted checkpoints and training prefixes, not held-out generalization or causal intent. Missing evidence is null. One category view cannot produce four-category macro estimates. No gradients, simulator traits, ratings, or review-text behavior are measured; official macro validation HR@10 alone selects models.
